title: dianthus liboschitzianus var. multicaulis
intro: Dianthus liboschitzianus var. multicaulis, commonly known as Balkan pink or Dianthus multicaulis, is a variety of flowering plant within the genus Dianthus. This perennial plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating various respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus liboschitzianus var. multicaulis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, the plant's antioxidant properties may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage.
